plan_owner_impacts.impact: Vault demonstrates the ledger-and-timeline composition: capacity meters, scrubbable SVG retention bars, hash-chipped receipts, and the stepped lifecycle wizard.
Settings Lifecycle treats export/import/copy/reset as stepped flows over the shared inventory; managed rows are skipped, never overwritten.
Five storage areas are visually separated and independently described; retention anchors/minima and legal holds render as timeline bars.
Artifacts carry PM-owned vs provider-native identity, redaction policy, retention, and hash receipts.
Worktree ledger + SVG branch graph + policy rows; GitHub Actions sits behind an explicit forge connection with a reachable setup state.
Docker/Podman/Kubernetes as human top-level cards with typed unavailable states and shared tool lifecycle language.
Provider update lifecycle in the shared manager; the future Updates module is reserved with this owner named.
SCM and container tools render exact installation health with the same confidence vocabulary as providers.
Lifecycle candidate IDs (export/import.*/reset.*/copy_from_project.*) annotated new in candidate-command-delta.json.
